comment: Each case merges `patch` into `base` (objects merge by key, null deletes a key, anything else replaces) and feeds the result to bind. `expected` is a subset of the BindOutput (arrays match element by element over the expected prefix); `executors` is the full ordered executor list of ranked.candidates; `skippedReasons` is the full ordered list of ranked.skipped reasons; `explainContains` lists substrings of the explain text.

config.$comment: ladder text lives in the crate

cases.name: explain producer inherits flagship from the prefix and binds claude opus
shape system: the workflow recommendation beats the prefix tier and the cap allows frontier
shape alternative spreads away from the family a soft peer already uses
shape constraint spreads to the third family
critique producer takes the seat tier key of its capability
critique reviewer is hard independent of the producer family
critique red-team takes the role taste from the prefix and is pairwise independent at high rigor
a checker pair is only soft below high rigor, so a shared family is allowed and recorded
the same pair at high rigor is hard, so the shared family is refused naming both peers
variant A: a capability tier of standard does not lower a workflow recommendation of frontier
variant A: a seat without a recommendation runs the capability default
variant B: above the global ceiling the tier is lowered, visibly, and the lowering names both lines
explainContains: tier: flagship (max-tier-cap: maxTier = flagship), lowered from frontier (workflow:architecture-advisory/shape-proposals/system)

cases.name: a capability maxTier above the global value lets the tier pass
variant C: a prefer that names a family without a cell at the capped tier is refused with the line to change
a hard pin on a family with no cell at the tier is refused the same way
a family with no cell is skipped and the next family serves the seat
debate judge is hard independent of both sides
debate judge is refused when gemini and xai lack a flagship cell, naming both sides
debate sides default to standard and spread softly
a global maxTier of standard caps the judge visibly
seat key beats persona beats role beats workflow beats capability default
persona key beats role key
role key beats the workflow recommendation and the recommendation is reported
the exact capability entry beats the prefix entry for a tier key
a capability without a colon has no prefix line and no bare-verb fallback
prefer lists replace and are not merged; the seat list wins over the prefix list
with no prefer anywhere the tier list is the candidate list
the first role-level prefer is taken from the prefix map entry per key
an override at or below the resolved tier is accepted and named override
an override above the resolved tier is refused
an authorized door may raise by override, still under the ceiling
a persona an override names that raises the tier is refused
an authorized door lets the override persona raise and the tier source names it
an override persona that does not raise the tier is accepted without authorization
acceptDependence is ignored unless the door is authorized
acceptDependence is honoured when the door is authorized
a pinned invocation that the executor has binds exactly that invocation
a pinned invocation the executor lacks is refused and never swapped for another
a lone pin that fails does not stop a second family from serving the seat
a run-wide override pin that cannot apply is skipped, not refused
the same pin on a seat's own override (not run-wide) is refused
a cell effort is carried into the candidate and named as the cell's
an override effort below the cell is refused
an override effort at or above the cell is accepted
a cell with no effort runs on the invocation default and says so
an effort the CLI cannot render skips that candidate and the next serves
an effort the pinned CLI cannot render is refused and lists the rendered levels
effective rigor never changes effort or tier
an ask whose candidates are all tool executors is not an agent seat
governance rejects a disallowed executor
a required skill the executor does not declare skips it
a blind seat is not bound to an in-process candidate
a forced out-of-process seat leases even when the executor would run in-process
an in-process seat needs no cell and no account
an unregistered executor is skipped by name, and a seat with none registered says so
nothing configured for the seat is no-candidate with zero configured
accounts come back sticky first, then probed, and quarantined or failed ones are out
a pool where every account is quarantined gives no candidate for that entry
an account without a login store for the invocation's CLI is not usable
a pool other than the family's with no account cannot pay for the call
two entries of one cell are two candidates in cell order and both pools can serve
a fault excludes one pool and keeps the other pool of the same family
an account pin selects its pool's survivors and pins the account
an account pin that names no account of the pool is refused
an account pin not written pool/account is refused
after a failure the walk follows tierFallback within the seat's own list and never revisits
the walk visits the rest of the failed family's cell entries before the next family
the walk never leaves the tier it started at
a list narrows the walk and the tier list cannot widen it
with no tier list the walk is the prefer order after the failed candidate
when every candidate has been tried the walk ends in a named refusal
a multi-round seat keeps executor and model and may rotate to another account of the same pool
a multi-round seat with no account left in its pool is refused, not moved to another family
a multi-round seat whose kept cell is gone is refused
an empty prefer list is a config error naming the line
a role key outside the five is a config error
a wrong tier name in a cell table is a config error
a protocol other than 1 is refused
a unit's own preference is listed ahead of the seat's prefer and its source is named
an executor that declares no invocation binds without naming one
a multi-round seat whose kept candidate already failed is refused, never walked to another family
an account pin naming a pool with no account list is refused with the config line to add
a seat with no candidate configured is run inline by the session lead
a blind seat is never run inline by the lead
a seat that needs a skill is never run inline by the lead
a seat whose configured candidates were all filtered is refused, not run inline
a seat with a configured candidate binds it and leaves the lead aside
